checks: source repositories and CC BY-SA 3.0 license files were inspected
email and URL direct-contact patterns are screened and excluded
deduplication is applied within each language
no sensitive-attribute inference or user profiling is performed
known_limitations: Public proper names and public-event references are retained as part of the source text.
The pattern screen is not a comprehensive personal-data detector.
This is an internal evaluation pilot, not a general-purpose personal-data corpus.
privacy_review.scope: Public news/Wikipedia treebank text only; no user-submitted or private chat data is included.

redistribution_notice: The verbatim sentence excerpts and scenario artifacts derived from them are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0 with attribution and share-alike terms. See ATTRIBUTION.md and LICENSE.txt.

semantic_gold.reason: PUD POS/dependency annotations are not independent USG semantic-frame or semantic-role gold.

translation_profile.arabic: All Arabic PUD sentences are translations: 750 originate in English and 250 originate in German, French, Italian, or Spanish and are translated via English; this is not a native-MSA distribution.
translation_profile.english: PUD contains news/Wikipedia sentences; 750 are originally English and 250 are translations from other European languages.
